title: Puzzle-CAM
subtitle: Improved localization via matching partial and full features

idea.note: Paper Fig. 1 · class activation maps (CAMs) of one image from an image classifier trained with image-level labels

training.note: Recorded ResNet-50 runs (released training logs) · single-scale CAMs and train-set mIoU after every epoch · the paper numbers follow in the next scene

rows: The classification loss alone keeps the CAM on the discriminative parts.
Adding only the classification loss of the tiled patches is similar to the baseline.
Adding only the reconstruction loss improves localization for some classes, but several classes are no longer predicted.
With all losses, the CAM suppresses over-activation and covers the complete object.
losses.note: Paper Fig. 3 and Table 1 · CAMs of one image and CAM mIoU on the PASCAL VOC 2012 train set, ResNet-50 backbone

results.line: Image-level labels only · no extra parameters · PASCAL VOC 2012
results.note: Examples from the ICIP 2021 presentation: segmentation results predicted by AffinityNet and by Puzzle-CAM · numbers from the paper
